articles.summary: ORLANDO, Fla. , Sept. 02, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LENSAR , Inc. (Nasdaq: LNSR) (“LENSAR” or the “Company”) today announced that a majority of the independent members of LENSAR’s board of directors granted three newly-hired non-executive employees an aggregate of 660 restricted stock units
articles.title: LENSAR Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
